payload.author: claude
payload.body: Done: merged to main + pushed (origin/main @ 65c5d4c). FR-110 (ServerOptions.projections registration + schema-source validation) + FR-111 (gateway projection subscribe -> initial tenant-scoped snapshot + live ProjectionDelta fan-out) shipped. Also fixed a latent bug: upsertObjectWithPolicy (the HTTP PUT /objects + WS ObjectUpsert path) now fires projection + search notifications (previously only the legacy positional method did). End-to-end WS test added; full suite 908 passed; verify:generated clean. No wire/@frick/core change needed. FR-112 (Swift/Kotlin parity) remains the deferred follow-up.
